title: Agent Retry Loop Auditor input
description: Provide AI-agent traces or flat OpenTelemetry-like spans. The Actor detects repeated failure signatures, immediate same-input retries, error streaks, terminal failures, and recovery transitions without using an LLM.

traces.title: Traces
traces.description: Trace objects. Supports objects with spans and AgentTrace-style llm_steps, or direct event/span-like objects.

spans.title: Flat spans
spans.description: Alternative flat span array. traceId/sessionId attributes are used to group spans.

repeatThreshold.title: Repeated failure threshold
repeatThreshold.description: Minimum occurrences of the same failure signature before it is reported as a repeated failure cluster.

maxItems.title: Maximum traces
maxItems.description: Maximum trace groups to audit in one run.
